sequences.name: Look, White Flowers from the Ruins of Dreams
sequences.descriptionTemplate:
Lily is immune to interruption while casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color>.
While <color=Highlight><te href=151203>Cradle Lullaby</te></color> is active, each <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily now grants 2 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=151204>Dream Aroma</te></color>.

sequences.name: Listen, a Requiem from the Dream Cradle
sequences.descriptionTemplate: While <color=Highlight><te href=151203>Cradle Lullaby</te></color> is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts an <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=151204>Dream Aroma</te></color> additionally increases Crit. Rate by 2% and Crit. DMG by 6%.

sequences.name: May Your Soul Wander No More
sequences.descriptionTemplate:
Lily additionally gains 170 points of <color=Highlight><te href=151201>Dream Perfume</te></color> upon entering combat, triggered once every 12s. After Lily casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom</color>, she additionally gains 170 points of <color=Highlight><te href=151201>Dream Perfume</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle</color> additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy.
Dealing DMG with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> additionally restores 10 points of Resonance Energy.
During <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>, Lily gains <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color> faster.

sequences.name: May Your Past Sink into Silence
May You Find Peace in Endless Light
sequences.descriptionTemplate: While Lily is in <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color>, the pull-in effect range is increased by 50% when a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>.

sequences.name: May My Reverie Never End
sequences.descriptionTemplate:
The <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> dealt by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> is increased by 100%.
The <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> dealt by <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom</color> is increased by 700%.

skills.name: Mend and Cleanse
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Title>Basic Attack</color>
Press repeatedly or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

<color=Title>Dodge Counter</color>
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

skills.name: Dream Blend
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend</color>
Lily starts with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> by default. When <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> is active, press Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to nearby targets, then switch to <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>.
This skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend</color>.

<color=Title>Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend</color>
When <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> is active, press Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to nearby targets, then switch to <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color>.
This skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend</color>.

values.name: Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend/Nightmare Blend Cooldown
Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend/Nightmare Blend Concerto Regen

skills.name: Into the Dream Cradle
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Casting this skill sends Lily into <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> and grants her <color=Highlight><te href=151203>Cradle Lullaby</te></color>.
Casting this skill also grants Lily a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

<color=Title>Slumberland</color>
Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color>, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color>, use directional input to command <color=Highlight>Dreambind</color> to attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to nearby targets. <color=Highlight>Dreambind</color> pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s while attacking, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. Press Resonance Liberation again during <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> to end it early.
When Lily is in <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> and a Resonator in the team other than Lily casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, targets within a certain range are pulled in. This effect can be triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> keeps Lily on the field but stops the attacks of <color=Highlight>Dreambind</color>. Lily leaves the field when <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator. Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom</color> also ends <color=Highlight>Slumberland</color> immediately.

<color=Title>Cradle Lullaby</color>
Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> cast by a Resonator in the team other than Lily grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=151204>Dream Aroma</te></color>. <color=Highlight>Cradle Lullaby</color> is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.

<color=Title>Dream Aroma</color>
Stacks up to 4 times. Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators in the team by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when <color=Highlight>Cradle Lullaby</color> ends.

skills.name: Blooming Dream
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Title>First Bloom</color>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

<color=Title>Eternal Bloom</color>
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle</color>, Lily's next Intro Skill <color=Highlight>First Bloom</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Eternal Bloom</color>. When cast, it attacks the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting this skill grants <color=Highlight>Deep Dream Fragrance</color> for 8s. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Deep Dream Fragrance</color> to additionally grant 100 points of <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color>.
Press <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: Blooming Fragrance
skills.descriptionTemplate: Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Pistols
skills.descriptionTemplate: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

skills.name: Dreamland of Flowers
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Title>Dream Perfume</color>
Can hold up to 300 points.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> restore <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color> when dealing damage.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend</color> restores 130 points of <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom</color> restores 130 points of <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color>.

<color=Title>Dreambell Chime</color>
Can hold up to 300 points.
Can be gained continuously during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>. Any unconsumed <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color> will be converted into an equal amount of <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color>
When <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color> is full, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color>, consuming all <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color> to grant 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Dream Shelter</color>. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> grants Lily <color=Highlight>Wish of Praying Dream</color>.
Switching to another Resonator during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> ends the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color> and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color> reaches 300 points, press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to end the skill immediately and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color>. <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> is automatically cast at the end of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> consumes all <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color>
Attack targets within range, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains <color=Highlight>Sillage</color> for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes <color=Highlight>Sillage</color> and grants <color=Highlight><te href=151202>Silvered Dream</te></color> to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched out while casting this skill.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>
When <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color> is full, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>, consuming all <color=Highlight>Dream Perfume</color> to grant 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Dream Shelter</color>. During the skill, Lily pulls in nearby targets and continuously deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to them. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> grants Lily <color=Highlight>Wish of Praying Dream</color>.
Switching to another Resonator during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> ends the skill immediately.
Lily continuously gains <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color> and Concerto Energy (up to 30 points) during the skill.
When <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color> reaches 300 points, press or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to end the skill immediately and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color>. <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> is automatically cast at the end of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> consumes all <color=Highlight>Dreambell Chime</color>.

<color=Title>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color>
Attack targets within range, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Lily gains <color=Highlight>Sillage</color> for 6s while casting this skill. Casting Outro Skill consumes <color=Highlight>Sillage</color> and grants <color=Highlight><te href=151202>Silvered Dream</te></color> to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 20s.
Lily cannot be switched out while casting this skill.

<color=Title>Silvered Dream</color>
Lasts for 30s.
When the Resonator with this effect is the active Resonator and can trigger Unison Response, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> on the team increases their ATK by 0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, up to 7%, counting up to 4 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color>.
The active Resonator's Echo Skill DMG gains more Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG. For every 0.7% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 190%, the Crit. Rate of Echo Skill DMG is increased by 0.1%, up to 10%, and the Crit. DMG of Echo Skill DMG is increased by 0.2%, up to 20%.
All Resonators in the team gain increased resistance to interruption.

<color=Title>Dream Shelter</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Dream Shelter</color>, stacking up to 1 time. <color=Highlight>Dream Shelter</color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> ends, or when <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> is interrupted. Receiving damage from an enemy target consumes 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Dream Shelter</color> to grant Lily immunity to interruption and reduce the DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

<color=Title>Wish of Praying Dream</color>
Can be gained once every 25s.
When Lily has <color=Highlight>Wish of Praying Dream</color>, the current <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Wish of Praying Dream</color> to increase the skill's healing by 400%.

values.name: Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale/Phantasm's End Concerto Regen

skills.name: Woven Scent
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom</color> additionally restores 10 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> additionally restores 15 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.

skills.name: Flowers for You
skills.descriptionTemplate:
While a nearby active Resonator has 50% or more HP, Lily grants them 10% DMG Reduction.
When a Resonator in the team takes a fatal blow, they will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 10% of Lily's Max HP for 10s. This effect can be triggered once every 5 min.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Phantasm's End</color> grants Lily <color=Highlight>Floral Blessing</color>.

<color=Title>Floral Blessing</color>
Lasts for 60s. When the HP of a surviving Resonator in the team is below 50% of their Max HP, restore 50% of their Max HP and remove <color=Highlight>Floral Blessing</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 120s.
